overview: 今日共收录72篇文献，覆盖机器学习、计算物理和功能材料方向。
trends: 文献主要涉及结构—性质建模、有限温度/动力学模拟以及材料电子与磁性问题；缺少原文细节的条目不作定量推断。

full_list.title_en: Atomistic simulations of electrochemical systems with machine learning potentials
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Atomistic simulations of electrochemical systems with machine learning potentials
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.15939v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Modern machine learning potentials (MLPs) enable large-scale atomistic simulations at unprecedented accuracy. The incorporation of explicit physical interactions such as long-range electrostatics has continuously broadened their applicability to increasingly complex systems in chemistry and materials science. Extending MLPs to electrochemistry and electrocatalysis, however, is still challenging as it requires the consideration of electrode potentials and electric fields in the atomic interactions. Such approaches have emerged only recently, and although the field is evolving rapidly, further conceptual advances are still needed for carrying out reliable simulations at finite temperature under applied potential. In this review, we provide a comprehensive overview about recent progress in the atomistic simulation of electrified interfaces using MLPs. Current developments fall into three different categories. The first comprises linear response models that describe polarisation, polarisability, and Born effective charges, extending conventional MLPs to finite electric fields. The second includes methods that directly learn a field-dependent potential energy surface. The third consists of a series of hybrid approaches combining classical models with machine learning. Although still under active development, these methods represent a major step toward more realistic simulations approaching the quality of electronic structure calculations. Finally, we discuss open challenges and possible future directions for advancing MLP-based simulations aiming for a bottom-up understanding of atomistic processes at electrified interfaces.

full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入热力学知情 ML、机器学习势、自由能采样、CALPHAD/团簇展开。从摘要能确认的线索包括：机器学习势与原子级动力学，以及声子、有限温度和输运性质, 晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“在 DFT 能量/力/应力之外加入跨温度构型、相对自由能、熵或热膨胀信息；用主动学习补采相变、畴壁和相竞争区域，再用热力学积分、MC 或有限温度 MD 验证”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：热力学知情 ML、机器学习势、自由能采样、CALPHAD/团簇展开已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到HfO₂ 基铁电、二维滑移铁电、钙钛矿和磁性氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注声子、有限温度和输运性质, 晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的热力学知情 ML、机器学习势、自由能采样、CALPHAD/团簇展开嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在HfO₂ 基铁电、二维滑移铁电、钙钛矿和磁性氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“在 DFT 能量/力/应力之外加入跨温度构型、相对自由能、熵或热膨胀信息；用主动学习补采相变、畴壁和相竞争区域，再用热力学积分、MC 或有限温度 MD 验证”补充训练/验证集，再比较《Atomistic simulations of electrochemical systems with machine learning potentials》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: AI4Plasma I: Data-Efficient Surrogate Modeling of Capacitively Coupled Plasma Fields
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：AI4Plasma I: Data-Efficient Surrogate Modeling of Capacitively Coupled Plasma Fields
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.15002v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Reference capacitively coupled plasma (CCP) simulations provide spatially resolved plasma fields but are costly to generate across operating conditions. We compare the data efficiency of five surrogate architectures--Coordinate MLP, PCA-Net, U-Net, Fourier neural operator (FNO), and Transolver--for predicting RF-cycle-averaged electron density, ion density, electric potential, and electron temperature in 1D planar and 2D axisymmetric GEC CCP benchmarks. We assess the number of reference simulations needed to achieve 1% and 2% mean relative L2 error for parameter-interior and parameter-boundary test cases, and examine architecture-specific mechanisms. FNO achieves the lowest or joint-lowest reference-case requirement in seven of eight comparisons. In 1D, FNO reaches 1% interior error with 50 training cases, compared with 100 for Transolver and 200 for U-Net. In 2D, FNO and U-Net each reach 1% interior error with 100 cases; FNO and Transolver each reach 2% parameter-boundary error with 200 cases, compared with 400 for U-Net. At the stricter 1% 2D parameter-boundary target, Transolver requires 400 cases versus 800 for FNO. Additional analyses investigate FNO spectral modes and padding, U-Net skip connections, Transolver adaptive slicing, and PCA-Net projection versus prediction error. The results support FNO as a data-efficient baseline for the tested CCP settings, while showing that the preferred architecture depends on the accuracy target and operating-parameter region.

full_list.title_en: Systematic Evaluation of Training Data Generation Strategies for Machine Learning-Based Molecular and Materials Property Prediction
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Systematic Evaluation of Training Data Generation Strategies for Machine Learning-Based Molecular and Materials Property Prediction
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.16792v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Machine-learning (ML) models for molecular and materials property prediction are often trained on large datasets curated through arbitrary or generic sampling strategies. Such approaches can lead to the over- or under-representation of regions of chemical and materials space that are most relevant to the prediction task. An important challenge is therefore how to efficiently curate training data to maximize predictive performance while minimising the number of labelled examples required. Here, we systematically compare training data acquisition strategies for molecular and materials property prediction, ranging from random sampling to various active learning approaches. We evaluate their performance across different model classes, representations, datasets, and target properties. Our results show that the effectiveness of data acquisition strategies depend strongly on the interplay between the model, dataset, and prediction task, although uncertainty-based sampling generally outperforms alternative strategies. Based on these findings, we derive guidelines for selecting data acquisition strategies under a given labelling budget.

full_list.title_en: Partition of Unity Data-driven Finite Element Method for Anisotropic Diffusion in Magnetized Plasmas
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Partition of Unity Data-driven Finite Element Method for Anisotropic Diffusion in Magnetized Plasmas
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.17086v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Numerical simulation of transport processes in magnetized plasmas is characterized by extreme anisotropy, where diffusion along magnetic field lines can be many orders of magnitude larger than in the perpendicular direction. This anisotropy leads to thin, steep boundary layers and numerical pollution that standard finite element methods struggle to resolve without prohibitive mesh refinement. In this paper, we introduce the Partition of Unity Data-Driven Finite Element Method (PU-DDFEM), a data-driven local model reduction approach, for anisotropic diffusion. The method utilizes a bottom-up construction to enable a complete offline-online splitting. We parametrize the local magnetic field and boundary conditions to generate a snapshot space that captures the essential physics of plasma confinement. Dominant modes are extracted via a local spectral problem to identify representative features. These modes are then mapped to the global domain using a partition of unity to form a conforming approximation space. This ensures that the basis functions are fully reusable across different global magnetic configurations, significantly reducing the online computational overhead for large-scale plasma simulations.

full_list.title_en: AI4Plasma II: Geometry-Aware Surrogate Modeling for Variable Electrode Gap GEC Plasmas
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：AI4Plasma II: Geometry-Aware Surrogate Modeling for Variable Electrode Gap GEC Plasmas
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.15584v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Industrial plasma process development requires broad exploration of operating and geometric parameters. Geometric parameters, particularly electrode spacing, affect discharge structure and processing uniformity. Exploring these parameter spaces through repeated high-fidelity simulations can be computationally expensive. Surrogate models can offer rapid predictions, but geometric variation complicates their application because the computational domain and discretization may change across samples. In this work, six geometry-aware surrogate models based on prescribed and learned geometry mappings, extended-domain representation, continuous coordinates, and geometry-native discretizations are compared in terms of their data requirements for accurate predictions of full plasma fields and ion density profiles near the wafer. The simulation dataset spans pressure, voltage, frequency, and electrode gap, with each reference case requiring an average simulation cost of 5.32 CPU h. To achieve a 2% mean error across the four plasma fields, prescribed-mapping Geo-FNO and Transolver require 100 training cases, compared with 250-1000 for the other models. Predicting ion density profiles near the wafer is more demanding and reveals larger differences among models, with prescribed-mapping Geo-FNO requiring the fewest training cases for the profile accuracy targets considered. To further reduce the data required for accurate predictions near the wafer, we introduce charge-separation weighting into the training loss, which reduces the prescribed-mapping Geo-FNO's minimum tested training requirement for a 5% profile error from 1000 to 100 cases. These results support prescribed-mapping Geo-FNO as a practical starting point for the variable-gap problem studied here when a suitable geometry mapping is available, while Transolver achieves the highest prediction accuracy with sufficient training data.

full_list.title_en: Data-driven non-contiguous photon-energy groups for fast multigroup radiation transport in line-dominated plasmas
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Data-driven non-contiguous photon-energy groups for fast multigroup radiation transport in line-dominated plasmas
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.15095v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Opacity of mid- and high-Z plasmas is dominated by thousands of overlapping spectral lines. Examples are laser-produced plasmas for extreme-ultraviolet (EUV) lithography, inertial-fusion hohlraums, and stellar interiors. Radiation transport in such plasmas needs more than 1000 photon-energy groups in the EUV case, and this makes radiation-hydrodynamic simulations very expensive. We show that the accuracy of a small-group opacity model can be recovered by choosing properly emphwhich fine bins are put into the same group. We present a data-driven method that assigns the fine bins of a detailed opacity and emissivity table to K emphnon-contiguous groups. Each group has a fixed spectral shape inside it. The groups follow from one requirement: the reduced absorption operator must be diagonal for every plasma state. They are determined from a Gram matrix of spectra, taken from detailed-group solutions of a small part, for example 5% in this work, of the parameter space. The reduced model is a set of K uncoupled flux-limited diffusion equations. It can be used in an existing multigroup code by replacing the opacity table. For a Sn plasma with electron densities of 4×10¹⁵--1.1×10²¹~cm⁻³, electron temperatures of 5--250~eV, and scale lengths of 2.5--6900um, the model with K=100 reproduces the total flux of the 1500-group reference with a median error of 2% and a 90th-percentile error of 8%. The 90th-percentile error is ten times smaller than that of a conventional 100-group model at the same cost.

full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Compensated Grid-Based Hybrid Exchange - A Simple, Accurate, Efficient, and Differentiable Recipe for Large-Scale Molecular Systems
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.16420v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A compensated grid-based approach is developed for hybrid exchange in large-scale molecular systems. The method uses a symmetrically overlap-fitted grid-based exchange approach, with fitting performed in the orthonormalized atomic orbital basis. This fitting is augmented with a superposition-of-atomic-densities difference-density (dSCF) partitioning of the exchange energy, yielding the finished compensated grid-based exchange approach. The complete method is found to have orders of magnitude reduction of absolute and relative error properties versus raw grid-based exchange, and remains analytically differentiable. The method is easy to implement and provides efficiency gains over GPU integral-direct techniques for high quality and/or augmented basis sets. Library functions to help users implement the method in their own quantum chemistry codes are provided in the recently-shipped cuEST v0.3 library.

full_list.title_en: HARMONY: an efficient and accurate deep learning framework for prediction of experimental vibrational spectra
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：HARMONY: an efficient and accurate deep learning framework for prediction of experimental vibrational spectra
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.16342v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Predicting experimental vibrational spectra requires both efficient molecular calculations and a reliable mapping from theoretical vibrations to measured signals. Here we introduce HARMONY, a two-stage deep-learning framework that bridges this gap using harmonic spectra as physical anchors. Equivariant neural networks directly predict atomic forces and spectroscopic tensors for rapid harmonic-spectrum construction, while HarmoNet combines these spectra with molecular topology and measurement metadata to predict experimental infrared and Raman spectra. HARMONY achieves mean cosine similarities of 0.912 for infrared and 0.907 for Raman spectra, with a mean inference time of 2.12~s per molecule, approximately 600-fold faster than the evaluated DFT workflow. Beyond forward prediction, HARMONY improves inverse molecular inference through pseudo-experimental pretraining and spectral verification of candidate structures. Integrating HARMONY and Vib2Mol as scientific tools within a general-purpose agent enables adaptive candidate generation and verification. With molecular formulas provided, the resulting Vib2Mol--HARMONY Agent achieves Top-1 recall of 70.53% on NIST using infrared spectra and 83.33% on SDBS using combined infrared and Raman spectra. Fine-tuning with 19 amino-acid controls and eight peptides further increases mean Raman cosine similarity from 0.669 to 0.896 on 15 held-out peptides. HARMONY establishes harmonic anchoring as a practical connection between molecular physics, experimental spectroscopy and adaptive molecular structure elucidation.

full_list.title_en: Are Scaling Laws of Universal MLIPs Universal?
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Are Scaling Laws of Universal MLIPs Universal?
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.15603v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Neural scaling laws enable the prediction of returns from larger training datasets, but machine-learned interatomic potential (MLIP) datasets are heterogeneous and expensive to generate, and equal numbers of structures need not contain equal amounts of useful information. We study data scaling under fixed model configurations for M3GNet, MACE, and PET trained on subsets of a combined MatPES-MP-ALOE training pool. Across training structure subsets from 10,000 to 640,000, together with the full 1.16-million-structure training set, we compare uniform random sampling, three chemistry- and structure-informed stratification policies, iterative DIRECT, and furthest-point sampling using embeddings from three pretrained MLIPs. Models are evaluated using cohesive-energy, force, stress, and aggregate losses on both a held-out test set from the parent distribution and the distribution shifted MP-r²SCAN test set. We observe power-law scaling improvements with increasing data, but the fitted scaling exponent, apparent error floor, and relative sample efficiency depend on the model architecture, target quantity, data sampling policy, and test set distribution. Sampling-policy rankings can reverse across test distributions: chemical stratification can improve cross-dataset performance while degrading in-distribution performance, whereas the embedding-space diversity policies frequently under-perform random sampling. Relative loss is strongly associated with test-to-train chemical-space divergence. These results show that structure count is a necessary but insufficient scaling variable for MLIPs. For training MLIPs, the return on additional first-principles calculations depends not only on how many additional structures are included, but also on how their chemical and configurational content aligns with the model's intended use.

full_list.title_en: Materials research with a general-purpose agent
full_list.title_zh: 使用通用代理进行材料研究
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.15451v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Over the last decade we have built Alexandria, an open database of about 15 million density-functional calculations of crystals. It includes PBE, PBEsol, SCAN and TB-mBJ results, structures relaxed at pressures up to 150 GPa, dielectric tensors and about 145,000 electron-phonon calculations, together with more than 400 million structures relaxed with machine-learned potentials. On these data we trained a generative model for crystal structures, a universal interatomic potential and graph neural networks for more than ten properties, from band gaps to superconducting critical temperatures. From the convex hull we computed a reaction graph of the 17.4 billion reactions between its 193,416 stable compounds. Here we give all of this to a general-purpose language-model agent. Working unattended, the agent screens the database for a solar absorber, drops a candidate whose synthesis releases too little energy, and writes a synthesis plan with precursors, crucible and atmosphere. Asked about the well-studied Ba-Zr-S system, it finds an unreported sulfide and designs the experiment that would confirm or rule it out. Asked for an air-stable alternative, it designs one and tests it against new structures from the generative model. With web search alone, the same agent proposes what the literature already discusses. Put together, the data, the models and the reaction graph let a general agent do what none of them does alone: go from a question in plain words to an experiment that a laboratory can run and test.
full_list.abstract_zh: 在过去十年中，我们建立了 Alexandria，这是一个包含约 1500 万个晶体密度泛函计算的开放数据库。它包括 PBE、PBEsol、SCAN 和 TB-mBJ 结果、在高达 150 GPa 的压力下松弛的结构、介电张量和约 145,000 个电子声子计算，以及超过 4 亿个通过机器学习势松弛的结构。根据这些数据，我们训练了晶体结构的生成模型、通用原子间势以及从带隙到超导临界温度等十多种属性的图神经网络。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 在过去十年中，我们建立了 Alexandria，这是一个包含约 1500 万个晶体密度泛函计算的开放数据库。它包括 PBE、PBEsol、SCAN 和 TB-mBJ 结果、在高达 150 GPa 的压力下松弛的结构、介电张量和约 145,000 个电子声子计算，以及超过 4 亿个通过机器学习势松弛的结构。根据这些数据，我们训练了晶体结构的生成模型、通用原子间势以及从带隙到超导临界温度等十多种属性的图神经网络。根据凸包，我们计算了 193,416 种稳定化合物之间 174 亿次反应的反应图。在这里，我们将所有这些交给通用语言模型代理。该特工在无人值守的情况下，筛选数据库中的太阳能吸收器，放弃合成释放能量太少的候选者，并编写包含前体、坩埚和大气的合成计划。当被问及经过充分研究的 Ba-Zr-S 系统时，它发现了一种未报告的硫化物，并设计了实验来证实或排除它。当被要求提供一种空气稳定的替代方案时，它设计了一种替代方案，并根据生成模型的新结构对其进行了测试。仅通过网络搜索，同一代理人就提出了文献中已经讨论过的内容。将数据、模型和反应图放在一起，让通用智能体能够完成他们无法单独完成的事情：从简单的问题到实验室可以运行和测试的实验。

full_list.title_en: Coupled Electronic Structure and Phonon Transport Driven by Bonding Reconstruction in Ba-B-C Clathrates
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Coupled Electronic Structure and Phonon Transport Driven by Bonding Reconstruction in Ba-B-C Clathrates
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2609.32894v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Composition-driven changes in electron count, structural symmetry and bonding environment can couple the electronic and thermal responses in a material. Here, with density-functional theory and machine-learned interatomic potentials (MLIPs), we compare cubic BaB3C3 with its B-C substituted tetragonal counterpart, BaB2C4. The additional valence electron and accompanying change in crystal symmetry drive a transition from metallic BaB3C3 to semiconducting BaB2C4 and the formation of short/strong C-C bonds. The reconstructed bonding network hardens the phonon spectrum, with the maximum frequency increasing from 800 to 900. At room temperature, the in-plane lattice thermal conductivity increases from 7.6 to 18.7 W/mK, while the thermal transport alters from isotropic to anisotropic for BaB2C4. This enhancement is associated with the strengthened bonding network, higher phonon frequencies/group velocities, longer lifetimes and larger mean free paths. Machine learning potentials accurately reproduced the DFT-level energies and forces with negligible errors, and the harmonic and anharmonic features are benchmarked against explicit first-principles calculations. Our findings demonstrate that minimal B-C substitution provides a viable strategy to link composition- and structure-associated bonding reconstruction with correlated electronic and phononic alterations.

full_list.title_en: From Accurate Quantum Chemistry to Converged Thermodynamics for Ion Pairing in Solution
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：From Accurate Quantum Chemistry to Converged Thermodynamics for Ion Pairing in Solution
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2603.06800v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Quantitative prediction of thermodynamic properties in solution is essential for translating atomistic simulations into reliable chemical insight. As an exemplar system, the behaviour of CaCO₃ in water has been widely studied to understand its mineralization in seawater, with potential implications for carbon-capture strategies. However, making accurate computational predictions has been a long-standing challenge, requiring both highly accurate electronic structure methods and extensive statistical sampling. Here, we combine advances in machine learning and electronic structure theory to fully resolve the ion pairing free energy of CaCO₃ with explicit solvation. We show that achieving quantitative agreement with experiment requires going beyond density functional theory up to the ''gold-standard'' coupled cluster theory with single, double, and perturbative triple excitations [CCSD(T)]. We generate a set of systematically improvable models, enabling reliable insights into the initial association mechanism of Ca and CO₃ ions prior to nucleation while fully quantifying enthalpic and entropic effects. These quantitatively accurate models further resolve a long-standing lack of consensus surrounding the hydration mechanism of the calcium ion in solution. Our results demonstrate that CCSD(T)-level thermodynamic predictions of complex aqueous systems can now be routinely achieved.

full_list.title_en: Brute-force molecular dynamics simulation of aging in amorphous Ge₂Sb₂Te₅
full_list.title_zh: 非晶态 Ge2Sb2Te5 老化的强力分子动力学模拟
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.15664v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Chalcogenide alloys such as the prototypical Ge₂Sb₂Te₅ compound are used in phase change electronic memories due to their ability to undergo a fast and reversible transition between the amorphous and crystalline phases upon heating. The amorphous phase is subject to aging that leads to an increase in the electrical resistance, which is detrimental to the operation of the devices. Using a machine learning interatomic potential, we have investigated the structural relaxations responsible for aging in amorphous Ge₂Sb₂Te₅ in molecular dynamics simulations at temperatures slightly below the glass transition. The aging simulation, lasting about 100 ns, follows an equilibration of 24 ns at 400 K. During aging we observed an enhancement of the Peierls distortion in axial bonds which is a typical feature of these alloys that we relate to the widening of the electronic band gap computed within Density Functional Theory in smaller aged amorphous models. We also observed a marked reduction of the atomic mobility with an increase of the bond lifetimes during aging. However, we do not see a reduction in homopolar bonds, which are expected to be absent in the ideal aged glass and which should be removed on a much longer time scale.
full_list.abstract_zh: 硫属化物合金，例如典型的 Ge2Sb2Te5 化合物，由于其在加热时能够在非晶相和晶相之间进行快速且可逆的转变，因此被用于相变电子存储器。非晶相容易老化，导致电阻增加，这不利于器件的运行。利用机器学习原子间势，我们在略低于玻璃化转变的温度下，在分子动力学模拟中研究了导致非晶态 Ge2Sb2Te5 老化的结构弛豫。时效模拟持续约 100 ns，在 400 K 下达到 24 ns 的平衡。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 硫属化物合金，例如典型的 Ge2Sb2Te5 化合物，由于其在加热时能够在非晶相和晶相之间进行快速且可逆的转变，因此被用于相变电子存储器。非晶相容易老化，导致电阻增加，这不利于器件的运行。利用机器学习原子间势，我们在略低于玻璃化转变的温度下，在分子动力学模拟中研究了导致非晶态 Ge2Sb2Te5 老化的结构弛豫。时效模拟持续约 100 ns，在 400 K 下达到 24 ns 的平衡。在时效过程中，我们观察到轴向键中 Peierls 畸变的增强，这是这些合金的典型特征，我们将其与较小时效非晶模型中密度泛函理论计算出的电子带隙的加宽相关。我们还观察到老化过程中原子迁移率随着键寿命的增加而显着降低。然而，我们没有看到单极键的减少，预计理想的老化玻璃中不会出现单极键，并且应该在更长的时间范围内消除单极键。

full_list.method_point: 方法上，摘要目前只能确认：分子动力学与有限温度轨迹、密度泛函理论和电子结构计算。需要回到原文核对数据来源、标签定义、模型架构、物理约束和验证集，不能把题名直接等同于可迁移算法。若要接入团队的 ML 势或 Hamiltonian 流程，应先确认它是否同时学习能量、力、应力、自旋、极化或电子结构，以及是否报告跨材料/跨温度外推。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。

full_list.title_en: Competing Octahedral Tilting and B-Site Off-Centering Govern the Phase Diagram of CsGe₁₋ₓSnₓBr₃ Perovskite Alloys
full_list.title_zh: 竞争八面体倾斜和 B 位偏心控制 CsGe₁₋ₓSnₓBr₃ 钙钛矿合金的相图
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.15200v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Lead-free halide perovskites based on Ge and Sn avoid the toxicity of Pb, but the two cations favor different structural distortions. The stereochemically active Ge 4s² lone pair drives polar B-site off-centering, whereas the larger Sn²⁺ cation favors octahedral tilting. Here, we map how these two instabilities compete across the full composition range of CsGe₁₋ₓSnₓBr₃ using large-scale molecular dynamics simulations with a charge-aware machine-learned interatomic potential trained on hybrid-functional data. At low temperature the alloy exhibits a morphotropic phase boundary between x=0.60 and 0.65 that separates a ferroelectric monoclinic Cc phase from a monoclinic P2₁ phase with mixed antipolar and polar off-centering, with both the tilt pattern and the off-centering order changing discontinuously. The composition-temperature phase diagram reproduces the known transition sequences and temperatures of both end members and reveals an intermediate tetragonal I4/mcm phase near the boundary that has no counterpart in either parent compound. Above the transition temperatures the B cations remain locally off-centered but orientationally disordered. The structural transition at the boundary causes a jump in the band gap at low temperature, whereas at 350 K the gap decreases smoothly with Sn content. These results establish B-site mixing as a means to tune polar and rotational order in lead-free halide perovskites.
full_list.abstract_zh: 基于Ge和Sn的无铅卤化物钙钛矿避免了Pb的毒性，但这两种阳离子有利于不同的结构扭曲。具有立体化学活性的 Ge 4s² 孤对电子驱动极性 B 位点偏心，而较大的 Sn²⁺ 阳离子则有利于八面体倾斜。在这里，我们使用大规模分子动力学模拟以及在混合功能数据上训练的电荷感知机器学习原子间势，绘制了这两种不稳定性如何在 CsGe₁₋ₓSnₓBr₃ 的整个组成范围内竞争。

full_list.title_en: Single Spin Hall Conversion in the Hall Response of Magnetic-Insulator/Heavy-Metal Bilayers Identified by Odd Spin-Hall-Angle Dependence
full_list.title_zh: 由奇自旋霍尔角依赖性识别的磁绝缘体/重金属双层霍尔响应中的单自旋霍尔转换
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.15571v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The Hall response of magnetic-insulator/heavy-metal bilayers is usually ascribed to two successive spin Hall conversions and is therefore expected to be even in the spin Hall angle. Using distinct magnetic-field windows, we separate the Hall voltage of yttrium iron garnet bilayers with Ta and Pt of opposite spin Hall angle into contributions from magnetization- and magnetic-field-driven precession as well as from ordinary Hall effect. The field-driven component reverses sign between Ta and Pt, revealing a Hall response odd-in-spin-Hall-angle. The magnetization-driven component also has opposite signs for Ta and Pt, except for the thinnest heavy-metal layers. A drift-diffusion model with interface-generated spin currents describes this behavior: the field-driven component is predominantly carried by a single spin Hall conversion, and the magnetization-driven component is consistent with one as well. Other potential explanations, based on a description with a finite imaginary spin-mixing conductance rather than interface-generated spin currents, require unusually large values of this conductance, making this mechanism unlikely. Our findings advance the understanding of Hall responses in magnetic-insulator/heavy-metal bilayers toward a more general description.

full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构。从摘要能确认的线索包括：论文题目和摘要中可确认的方法，以及磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。

full_list.title_en: Model Order Reduction for Quantum Molecular Dynamics
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Model Order Reduction for Quantum Molecular Dynamics
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2509.07340v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Quantum molecular dynamics (QMD) provides a high-fidelity physical framework for modeling atomic and molecular phenomena from first principles. However, its mathematical formulation requires solving iterative, high-dimensional electronic structure problems at every physical state step. Within the broader data-driven computational mechanics paradigm, we present a projection-based model order reduction framework for electronic structure calculation in QMD. By discovering a low-dimensional manifold of the electronic solution space within Kohn-Sham density functional theory, our approach projects the governing variational formulation onto an intrinsically reduced subspace. This avoids full-space iterative wavefunction optimization while preserving rigorous physical symmetries and state consistency. We demonstrate this methodology on a water molecule, demonstrating strong agreement with high-fidelity reference solutions across structural trajectories and thermodynamic observables through canonical coordinate alignment and structured manifold sampling.

full_list.title_en: High-Throughput Surface Screening Reveals Energetically Competitive Low-Symmetry Facets in Wurtzite Semiconductors
full_list.title_zh: 高通量表面筛选揭示了纤锌矿半导体中具有能量竞争力的低对称面
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.15138v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Surfaces and interfaces govern the performance of wurtzite semiconductors in electronics, sensing, and solar-fuel conversion. To date, first-principles studies have focused mostly on high-symmetry low-index facets, owing to the computational cost and complexity of modelling low-symmetry high-index surfaces. In practice, however, surface formation energy is determined by the planar atomic density and the strength of the bonds severed upon cleavage, neither of which inherently excludes high-Miller-index surfaces from being energetically competitive. Here, we combine automated surface generation, machine-learning interatomic potential screening, and density functional theory to explore 226 clean, stoichiometric surface models of wurtzite GaN, LaN, and ZnO, spanning all Miller orientations with |h|,|k|,|l| le 3 and their inequivalent terminations. We find that low-symmetry high-index prismatic facets are energetically competitive with respect to the conventional m- and a-planes: nine of the fifteen lowest-energy nonpolar surfaces are high-index, and the five best candidates of each compound lie within only 2.5-5.3% of the minimum surface energy. Hybrid-functional calculations reveal, however, that this energetic proximity does not translate into similar electronic alignment. In GaN, the two most stable surfaces differ by just 0.08 J m⁻² in formation energy but by almost 0.8 eV in vacuum-referenced band-edge positions, whereas in LaN the nearly degenerate m- and a-planes are separated by 0.16 eV. Wurtzite facets with similar formation energies may therefore exhibit very different ionization potentials and electron affinities. Our results enable the joint, systematic assessment of stability and band alignment across the facets that can actually occur in wurtzites, and provide a map of candidate surfaces for the rational design of related nanostructure and heterointerfaces.
full_list.abstract_zh: 表面和界面决定着纤锌矿半导体在电子、传感和太阳能燃料转换方面的性能。迄今为止，由于低对称高折射率表面建模的计算成本和复杂性，第一原理研究主要集中在高对称低折射率面。然而，实际上，表面形成能是由平面原子密度和解理时切断的键的强度决定的，这两者都本质上排除了高米勒指数表面的能量竞争。在这里，我们结合自动表面生成、机器学习原子间势筛选和密度泛函理论，探索了纤锌矿 GaN、LaN 和 ZnO 的 226 个干净的化学计量表面模型，涵盖所有米勒方向 |h|、|k|、|l| 。

full_list.title_en: A System-Independent Metadynamics Strategy for Reactive Training Data: Application to Gas-Phase Organic Reactions
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：A System-Independent Metadynamics Strategy for Reactive Training Data: Application to Gas-Phase Organic Reactions
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2609.29105v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: General-purpose machine-learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) for organic reactions need to accurately describe both minimum-energy paths (MEPs) for evaluating reaction energetics and the broader configurational space for simulating reaction dynamics. Existing general datasets for gas-phase reactions largely rely on quasi-static optimization near MEPs, leaving off-MEP regions under-covered and model reliability in reactive molecular dynamics weakly supported; the gap is methodological, not a question of dataset size. We introduce a spatiotemporally resolved, system-independent collective variable (CV): Cartesian RMSD within randomly partitioned local domains against an expanding list of time-averaged reference geometries. The CV drives metadynamics as the exploration engine, supplemented by transition state (TS) optimization to augment coverage around TSs. Within a concurrent-learning workflow, this produces OpenRxn26, a dataset of 1.8~M DFT-labeled configurations covering neutral singlet unimolecular reactions in the H/C/N/O chemical space (N_heavy ≤ 30), containing reactive atomic environments underrepresented in community datasets. Trained on OpenRxn26, a DPA4 model (DPA4_rxn26) is the only model in the benchmark suite to achieve transferable sub-kcal/mol energy accuracy on barrier heights, reaction energies and off-MEP reactive trajectories, relative to the training DFT reference, demonstrating the efficiency and generality of the sampling strategy. Domain MLIPs performing well on static benchmarks degrade several-fold on off-MEP reactive trajectories (e.g. MACE-OMol25), showing the insufficiency of MEP-anchored benchmarks for guaranteeing dynamics reliability. The sampling strategy enables efficient development of reliable general-purpose reactive MLIPs, with OpenRxn26 as a demonstration of MD-ready training data for gas-phase neutral singlet organic reactions.

full_list.title_en: Machine-accelerated extraction of experimental superconducting parameters for physical insight and prediction across thousands of materials
full_list.title_zh: 机器加速提取实验超导参数，以实现对数千种材料的物理洞察和预测
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.15627v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: New superconductors could unlock next-generation technologies from nuclear fusion to lossless electronics. Machine learning can predict candidate superconductors but lacks validated experimental training data beyond the critical temperature. Here we present AutoSuperCon, a database of eight superconducting parameters, containing 20354 entries for 6793 superconductors. The data were extracted from over 47000 arXiv preprints using a large language model and validated against reference datasets (R² = 0.96 with NIMS SuperCon). Using AutoSuperCon, we show that median gap ratios rise from 3.6 in conventional superconductors to 6.4 in cuprates, 28% of upper critical fields exceed the Pauli limit, and critical temperatures lie below a ceiling proportional to the superfluid density. Further, we train composition-based predictors for the critical temperature (R²ₗₒg=0.83) and the upper critical field (R²ₗₒg=0.69), boosted by transfer learning. Within known superconducting families, composition alone is sufficient to screen candidates for both parameters. AutoSuperCon thus enables physical insight and data-driven discovery across thousands of superconductors.
full_list.abstract_zh: 新的超导体可以解锁从核聚变到无损电子学的下一代技术。机器学习可以预测候选超导体，但缺乏超过临界温度的经过验证的实验训练数据。在这里，我们介绍 AutoSuperCon，一个包含 8 个超导参数的数据库，其中包含 6793 个超导体的 20354 个条目。使用大型语言模型从 47000 多个 arXiv 预印本中提取数据，并根据参考数据集进行验证（NIMS SuperCon 的 R² = 0.96）。

full_list.method_point: 方法上，摘要目前只能确认：论文题目和摘要中可确认的方法。需要回到原文核对数据来源、标签定义、模型架构、物理约束和验证集，不能把题名直接等同于可迁移算法。若要接入团队的 ML 势或 Hamiltonian 流程，应先确认它是否同时学习能量、力、应力、自旋、极化或电子结构，以及是否报告跨材料/跨温度外推。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 与团队方向的可能连接在于：晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系。团队已有机器学习势、第一性原理、有效 Hamiltonian、缺陷计算、电子—声子耦合和有限温度动力学基础，但该文是否提供可复用数据或物理量仍需查证。若研究对象属于机器人、量子信息或电网等非材料场景，关联主要是物理约束学习、少样本建模或不确定性评估，而不是直接迁移材料机制。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对《机器加速提取实验超导参数，以实现对数千种材料的物理洞察和预测》的启示是先做可证伪的对接：从一个已有材料体系和小规模 DFT 基准开始，明确输入、目标、基线和外推测试，再决定是否接入铁电/磁性、缺陷或载流子动力学工作。具体可先把该文的表示或损失函数在 HfO₂、二维滑移铁电、CrI₃/CrSBr、SiC/GaN 缺陷或卤化物钙钛矿上做小规模复现；若没有直接交叉，应保留为方法参考而非强行迁移。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Quantum Material Generation via Coherent Hamiltonian Search
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Quantum Material Generation via Coherent Hamiltonian Search
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.16016v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Discovering new materials with targeted properties is a central goal of materials science, yet the space of candidates is vast. Data-driven generative models learn the distribution of known materials, but they extrapolate poorly, and a generated structure is not known to be stable. A material's properties follow from its Hamiltonian, and a quantum computer can calculate them from it. We introduce the quantum material generative algorithm (QMage), a coherent search, guided by the Hamiltonian, over crystalline configurations of atomic composition, unit cell structure, and atomic positions, for one whose calculated properties meet the targets to within a given error tolerance. The computation is a single coherent quantum circuit in which each configuration's Hamiltonian is block-encoded, its target eigenstate isolated and properties evaluated, and the satisfying configurations amplified by fixed-point search and measured. One framework covers many targets, from formation energy and band gaps to elasticity and conductivity. We design the algorithm for the mature fault-tolerant era and estimate its cost in logical qubits and Toffoli depth from a classically routine benchmark to targets where established methods are unreliable. The approach generates candidate materials from first principles, rather than generalizing from those known, and could enable materials discovery when the target properties are difficult to predict classically.
full_list.summary: Discovering new materials with targeted properties is a central goal of materials science, yet the space of candidates is vast. Data-driven generative models learn the distribution of known materials,…
full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入机器学习 Hamiltonian、带电缺陷形成能、缺陷扩散和非辐射复合。从摘要能确认的线索包括：有效哈密顿量或机器学习哈密顿量，以及晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“把电荷态、有限尺寸修正、局域配位和缺陷迁移路径纳入标注；用小超胞 DFT+U/GW 或缺陷形成能基准校准，再扩展到大超胞和有限温度扩散”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：机器学习 Hamiltonian、带电缺陷形成能、缺陷扩散和非辐射复合已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到SiO₂、SiC、GaN、卤化物钙钛矿、HfO₂ 氧空位和二维半导体。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的机器学习 Hamiltonian、带电缺陷形成能、缺陷扩散和非辐射复合嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在SiO₂、SiC、GaN、卤化物钙钛矿、HfO₂ 氧空位和二维半导体中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“把电荷态、有限尺寸修正、局域配位和缺陷迁移路径纳入标注；用小超胞 DFT+U/GW 或缺陷形成能基准校准，再扩展到大超胞和有限温度扩散”补充训练/验证集，再比较《Quantum Material Generation via Coherent Hamiltonian Search》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Local B-site chemistry controls oxygen-vacancy energetics in Ca-Ce-Ti-Mn perovskites for thermochemical hydrogen production
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Local B-site chemistry controls oxygen-vacancy energetics in Ca-Ce-Ti-Mn perovskites for thermochemical hydrogen production
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2607.28752v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Two-step thermochemical water splitting driven by concentrated solar heat is a scalable route to renewable hydrogen, but it requires oxides whose oxygen-vacancy formation energies balance facile reduction with favorable reoxidation. Perovskite solid solutions can tune this balance, but the relationship between bulk stoichiometry and local defect energetics remains poorly understood. Here we map oxygen-vacancy formation energetics across Ca-Ce-Ti-Mn (CCTM) perovskites by combining first-principles calculations with a coverage-constrained special quasirandom structure approach that realizes all fifteen symmetry-distinct oxygen nearest-neighbor environments, an interpretable crystal-feature model whose fitted coefficients directly encode the underlying Born-Haber thermochemistry, and a fine-tuned defect graph neural network. Local B-site chemistry dominates the oxygen-vacancy formation energy Eᵥ: varying the nearest-neighbor Mn fraction shifts Eᵥ by 1.0-1.5 eV depending on local Ce content, whereas A-site Ce variation contributes a smaller, Mn-dependent shift of 0.2-0.6 eV. Short-range B-site cation order, if it can be established and kinetically retained through processing, is therefore a candidate means of tuning redox performance without changing bulk composition. Composition-space maps identify a Ce/Mn-balanced region (~29-33% Ce on the A site and 58-67% Mn on the B site) combining a high fraction of vacancy sites within the targeted Eᵥ window with phase stability and solubility, whose predicted redox cycle capacity matches or exceeds the ceria benchmark at 1350 ^circC rather than the roughly 1600 ^circC ceria requires. Measurements on three CCTM compositions show cycle capacity increasing monotonically with Ce content under protocols close to the model conditions. The design rules are expected to transfer to related perovskite families.

full_list.title_en: SHRX: a neural surrogate of turbulent transport in tokamak plasma and its comparison with TORAX against experimental data
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：SHRX: a neural surrogate of turbulent transport in tokamak plasma and its comparison with TORAX against experimental data
full_list.abstract: Integrated tokamak modelling needs fast surrogates of turbulent transport, but existing ones depend on JAX. We built SHRX, a neural network with 29,283 parameters that runs on NumPy alone, by distilling the QuaLiKiz neural network (QLKNN). A “bridge” converts the state of our one-and-a-half-dimensional simulator SINTEZ into the ten dimensionless QLKNN inputs. For stiff transport we introduce the error of the critical-gradient factor, (:δ:f), as a metric, and an ensemble of five networks gives an uncertainty estimate. We compare SINTEZ with SHRX against the TORAX code at three levels: identical local plasma states, an integrated ITER discharge with identical inputs, and 206 conventional and 41 spherical records of the H-mode database of the International Tokamak Physics Activity (ITPA). On machines held out of training, the median error of the heat diffusivity (:χ:) is 9% and the median (:δ:f) is 2.3%; the ensemble lowers the (:χ:) error to 5.9–6.5%. The ITER fusion power is 492 MW with SINTEZ and SHRX, 478 MW with SINTEZ and QLKNN, and 532 MW with TORAX. On experimental records the two codes agree with each other ((:r=0.995) in (:lnW)) better than with the measurements, and both are less accurate than the IPB98(y,2) regression ((:σ:ₗₙ) of 0.55 and 0.56 against 0.21). On spherical tokamaks SHRX overestimates the stored energy by a median factor of 28. SHRX is a faster, JAX-free copy of QLKNN, not a better model than TORAX: most of the experimental error comes from inputs that both codes share.

full_list.title_en: Nested Ensemble Learning with Topological Data Analysis for Graph Classification and Regression
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Nested Ensemble Learning with Topological Data Analysis for Graph Classification and Regression
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.14900v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We propose a nested ensemble learning framework that utilizes Topological Data Analysis (TDA) to extract and integrate topological features from graph data, with the goal of improving performance on classification and regression tasks. Our approach computes persistence diagrams (PDs) using lower-star filtrations induced by three filter functions: closeness, betweenness, and degree2 centrality. To overcome the limitation of relying on a single filter, these PDs are integrated through a data-driven, three-level architecture. At Level-0, diverse base models are independently trained on the topological features extracted for each filter function. At Level-1, a meta-learner combines the predictions of these base models for each filter to form filter-specific ensembles. Finally, at Level-2, a meta-learner integrates the outputs of these filter-specific ensembles to produce the final prediction. We evaluate our method on both simulated and real-world graph datasets. Experimental results demonstrate that our framework consistently outperforms base models and standard stacking methods, achieving higher classification accuracy and lower regression error. It also surpasses existing state-of-the-art approaches, ranking among the top three models across all benchmarks.

full_list.implication: 对《Nested Ensemble Learning with Topological Data Analysis for Graph Classification and Regression》的启示是先做可证伪的对接：从一个已有材料体系和小规模 DFT 基准开始，明确输入、目标、基线和外推测试，再决定是否接入铁电/磁性、缺陷或载流子动力学工作。具体可先把该文的表示或损失函数在 HfO₂、二维滑移铁电、CrI₃/CrSBr、SiC/GaN 缺陷或卤化物钙钛矿上做小规模复现；若没有直接交叉，应保留为方法参考而非强行迁移。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: A Hierarchical Harmonic-to-Anharmonic Framework for ab initio Screening and Mechanistic Analysis of Negative Thermal Expansion in ZrV2O7
full_list.title_zh: 用于 ZrV2O7 负热膨胀从头筛选和机理分析的分层谐波到非谐波框架
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.15767v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Negative thermal expansion (NTE) in framework materials arises from complex lattice dynamics that are challenging to capture using conventional theoretical approaches. Here, we establish a hierarchical computational strategy for investigating NTE in ZrV2O7, integrating the quasiharmonic approximation (QHA), temperature-dependent effective potentials (TDEP), and machine-learning-accelerated ab initio molecular dynamics (ML-MD). Quasi-harmonic lattice-dynamical calculations identify low-frequency phonon modes with negative Grüneisen parameters as inexpensive screening descriptors, while TDEP incorporates finite-temperature anharmonicity and ML-MD further reveals temperature-dependent structural distortions that drive the lattice contraction. The observations are further corroborated with X-ray diffraction (XRD) measurements. The concurrent increase in transverse displacement (uT) provides microscopic evidence for a quasi-rigid-unit-mode (QRUM) mechanism underlying the NTE behaviour at elevated temperatures. This is consistent with previous reports on other framework materials, including ZrW2O7, where collective polyhedral rotations and transverse atomic motions have been linked to NTE. Overall, our results demonstrate how relatively inexpensive lattice-dynamical descriptors can identify potential NTE materials, while higher-level anharmonic simulations can then resolve the underlying structural mechanisms at the atomic scale.
full_list.abstract_zh: 框架材料中的负热膨胀（NTE）是由复杂的晶格动力学引起的，使用传统的理论方法很难捕捉到这一点。在这里，我们建立了一种分层计算策略来研究 ZrV2O7 中的 NTE，集成了准调和近似 (QHA)、温度相关有效势 (TDEP) 和机器学习加速从头算分子动力学 (ML-MD)。准谐波晶格动力学计算将具有负 Grüneisen 参数的低频声子模式识别为廉价的筛选描述符，而 TDEP 结合了有限温度非谐性，ML-MD 进一步揭示了驱动晶格收缩的温度相关结构畸变。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 框架材料中的负热膨胀（NTE）是由复杂的晶格动力学引起的，使用传统的理论方法很难捕捉到这一点。在这里，我们建立了一种分层计算策略来研究 ZrV2O7 中的 NTE，集成了准调和近似 (QHA)、温度相关有效势 (TDEP) 和机器学习加速从头算分子动力学 (ML-MD)。准谐波晶格动力学计算将具有负 Grüneisen 参数的低频声子模式识别为廉价的筛选描述符，而 TDEP 结合了有限温度非谐性，ML-MD 进一步揭示了驱动晶格收缩的温度相关结构畸变。 X 射线衍射 (XRD) 测量进一步证实了观察结果。横向位移 (uT) 的同时增加为高温下 NTE 行为的准刚性单元模式 (QRUM) 机制提供了微观证据。这与之前关于其他框架材料（包括 ZrW2O7）的报道一致，其中集体多面体旋转和横向原子运动已与 NTE 联系起来。总的来说，我们的结果证明了相对便宜的晶格动力学描述符如何能够识别潜在的 NTE 材料，而更高级别的非谐模拟可以在原子尺度上解决潜在的结构机制。

full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入非绝热分子动力学、电子—声子耦合、Wannier/GW-BSE 和载流子输运。从摘要能确认的线索包括：分子动力学与有限温度轨迹，以及声子、有限温度和输运性质, 晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“先用高精度电子结构和声子/电子—声子矩阵元建立小规模基准，再训练可迁移 Hamiltonian 或 ML 势，最后在长时间尺度非绝热 MD、输运或界面电荷转移中验证”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：非绝热分子动力学、电子—声子耦合、Wannier/GW-BSE 和载流子输运已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到卤化物钙钛矿、二维半导体、FeSe、光电界面和能源材料。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注声子、有限温度和输运性质, 晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。

full_list.title_en: Ferroelectric control of exciton photoluminescence in rhombohedrally stacked bilayer WSe₂
full_list.title_zh: 菱面体堆叠双层WSe₂中激子的铁电控制光致发光
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.16475v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Sliding ferroelectricity offers a non-volatile route to electrically programmable electronic and optical functionality, but deterministic control of excitonic photoluminescence is often obscured by moiré reconstruction and domain averaging. Here we study an artificially assembled WSe₂ bilayer with near-zero twist in rhombohedral stacking and observe reversible, hysteretic electrical switching through excitonic photoluminescence. Under an out-of-plane electric field, momentum-indirect QK exciton emission exhibits Stark-slope reversals and abrupt energy jumps, resolving a four-stage sequence separated by two band realignments and one ferroelectric switching event. Polarization reversal also selects the momentum-direct KK interlayer-exciton branch that hybridizes with an intralayer exciton, producing history-dependent photoluminescence. Ferroelectric modulation of resonant Raman scattering provides a complementary readout, with hysteretic intensities correlated with the polarization-dependent interlayer field. These results establish an exciton-based quantification of the electronic structure in ferroelectric WSe₂ and open a route to electrically programmable optoelectronic functionality.
full_list.abstract_zh: 滑动铁电性为电可编程电子和光学功能提供了一种非易失性途径，但激子光致发光的确定性控制通常因莫尔条纹重构和畴平均而变得模糊不清。本文中，我们研究了一种人工组装的WSe₂双层，其在菱面体堆叠中具有近乎零的扭转，并通过激子光致发光观察到可逆的滞后性电学开关。在面外电场下，动量间接的QK激子发射表现出斯塔克斜率反转和突发能量跃迁，揭示了一个由两次能带重排和一次铁电翻转事件分隔的四阶段序列。极化反转还会选择与层内激子杂化的动量直接KK层间激子分支，从而产生依赖于历史的光致发光。

full_list.title_en: Cation-intermixing driven evolution from a narrow avoided crossing to an enlarged inverted gap in Ge₂Bi₂Te₅
full_list.title_zh: 阳离子混合驱动 Ge2Bi2Te5 中从狭窄的避免交叉到扩大的倒置间隙的演变
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.15631v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Combining the building blocks and structural motifs of the topological insulator Bi₂Te₃ and the ferroelectric Rashba semiconductor GeTe, we synthesized and comprehensively characterized the resulting Ge₂Bi₂Te₅ compound, which exhibits pronounced cation intermixing. Using momentum-resolved photoemission spectroscopy and ab initio calculations, we demonstrate how cation intermixing drives the evolution of its electronic structure from a narrow avoided crossing to a substantially enlarged inverted band gap. We establish the microscopic origin of this behavior in the redistribution of Ge and Bi atoms within the cation sublattice, which increases the contribution of Bi-derived states near the valence-band maximum and enhances the effective contribution of spin-orbit coupling, thereby stabilizing the topological electronic structure. Our findings demonstrate that cation disorder, which can be controlled during crystal growth, provides an additional degree of freedom for engineering topological electronic structures, opening new opportunities for the development of functional quantum materials.
full_list.abstract_zh: 结合拓扑绝缘体 Bi2Te₃ 和铁电 Rashba 半导体 GeTe 的构建模块和结构图案，我们合成并全面表征了所得的 Ge2Bi2Te5 化合物，该化合物表现出明显的阳离子混合。使用动量分辨光电子能谱和从头计算，我们演示了阳离子混合如何驱动其电子结构从狭窄的避免交叉演化到大幅扩大的倒置带隙。我们确定了这种行为的微观根源在于阳离子亚晶格内Ge和Bi原子的重新分布，这增加了价带最大值附近Bi衍生态的贡献，并增强了自旋轨道耦合的有效贡献，从而稳定了拓扑电子结构。

full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：HfO₂ 铁电、二维滑移铁电、极化翻转、畴壁和疲劳/缺陷问题已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到HfO₂、Hf₀.₅Zr₀.₅O₂、二维范德华铁电、钙钛矿氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注铁电/多铁、极化翻转和电场驱动过程, 磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的HfO₂ 铁电、二维滑移铁电、极化翻转、畴壁和疲劳/缺陷问题嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在HfO₂、Hf₀.₅Zr₀.₅O₂、二维范德华铁电、钙钛矿氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“把电场、极化、应变、氧空位和局域结构序参一起纳入轨迹数据；比较均匀翻转、局域成核和畴壁传播，并用 DFT/有效 Hamiltonian 对关键路径复核”补充训练/验证集，再比较《阳离子混合驱动 Ge2Bi2Te5 中从狭窄的避免交叉到扩大的倒置间隙的演变》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Chiral-phonon-induced anomalous Hall effect in bilayer MoSe₂
full_list.title_zh: 双层 MoSe2 中手性声子诱导的反常霍尔效应
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.15761v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We demonstrate that optically driven chiral phonons induce an anomalous Hall response in a nonmagnetic, centrosymmetric material. Using first-principles calculations to parameterize an effective kcdotp Hamiltonian for bilayer MoSe₂, we show that circular excitation of an Eᵤ phonon generates a circular dynamical Rashba spin-orbit coupling. The resulting Floquet bands carry same-sign Berry curvature at the two valleys, producing a Hall response whose sign follows the phonon handedness. We obtain a range of σₓysim10⁻²-0.21 frace²2πhbar for experimentally accessible light pulses. Our results show that chiral phonons provide a route to controlling electronic Berry curvature and transport on ultrafast time scales.
full_list.abstract_zh: 我们证明光学驱动的手性声子会在非磁性中心对称材料中引起异常霍尔响应。使用第一原理计算来参数化双层 MoSe2 的有效 kcdotp 哈密顿量，我们表明 Eᵤ 声子的圆形激发会产生圆形动力学 Rashba 自旋轨道耦合。由此产生的 Floquet 带在两个谷处具有相同符号的贝里曲率，产生霍尔响应，其符号遵循声子旋向性。我们获得了 σₓysim10⁻²-0.21 frace²2πhbar 的范围，用于实验上可获得的光脉冲。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 我们证明光学驱动的手性声子会在非磁性中心对称材料中引起异常霍尔响应。使用第一原理计算来参数化双层 MoSe2 的有效 kcdotp 哈密顿量，我们表明 Eᵤ 声子的圆形激发会产生圆形动力学 Rashba 自旋轨道耦合。由此产生的 Floquet 带在两个谷处具有相同符号的贝里曲率，产生霍尔响应，其符号遵循声子旋向性。我们获得了 σₓysim10⁻²-0.21 frace²2πhbar 的范围，用于实验上可获得的光脉冲。我们的结果表明，手性声子提供了一种在超快时间尺度上控制电子贝里曲率和传输的途径。

full_list.title_en: Defective α-In₂Se₃ from first principles
full_list.title_zh: 第一原理中的缺陷α-In2Se₃
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.15060v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: α-In₂Se₃ is a two-dimensional van der Waals material with promising applications involving ferroelectricity. However, the presence of native defects can significantly influence its structural and electronic properties. In this work, we employ density functional theory with a state-of-the-art meta-generalized gradient approximation (meta-GGA) exchange-correlation functional to investigate the electronic structure of bulk α-In₂Se₃ and the formation of neutral point defects, including vacancies and antisites, under Se-rich and In-rich growth conditions. Our calculations reproduce the experimental structural parameters of the pristine material and reveal that the Se vacancy in the middle layer exhibits an unexpectedly low formation energy under both chemical environments. Structural analysis shows that the neighboring tetrahedrally coordinated In atom undergoes a substantial local relaxation along the three-fold axis, which preserves its C₃ᵥ site symmetry even as its coordination is reduced from four to three, providing a microscopic explanation for the remarkable stability of this defect.
full_list.abstract_zh: α-In2Se₃是一种二维范德华材料，在铁电方面具有广阔的应用前景。然而，天然缺陷的存在会显着影响其结构和电子特性。在这项工作中，我们采用密度泛函理论和最先进的元广义梯度近似（meta-GGA）交换相关函数来研究富硒和富硒生长条件下块体α-In2Se3的电子结构以及中性点缺陷（包括空位和反位点）的形成。我们的计算重现了原始材料的实验结构参数，并揭示了中间层的 Se 空位在两种化学环境下都表现出出乎意料的低形成能。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: α-In2Se₃是一种二维范德华材料，在铁电方面具有广阔的应用前景。然而，天然缺陷的存在会显着影响其结构和电子特性。在这项工作中，我们采用密度泛函理论和最先进的元广义梯度近似（meta-GGA）交换相关函数来研究富硒和富硒生长条件下块体α-In2Se3的电子结构以及中性点缺陷（包括空位和反位点）的形成。我们的计算重现了原始材料的实验结构参数，并揭示了中间层的 Se 空位在两种化学环境下都表现出出乎意料的低形成能。结构分析表明，邻近的四面体配位 In 原子沿三重轴经历了显着的局部弛豫，即使其配位从 4 个减少到 3 个，也保留了其 C₃ᵥ 位点对称性，为该缺陷的显着稳定性提供了微观解释。

full_list.title_en: Going beyond the standard quasiparticle picture: Entanglement spreading after quenching from highly entangled states
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Going beyond the standard quasiparticle picture: Entanglement spreading after quenching from highly entangled states
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.15409v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The quasiparticle picture provides a quantitative description of entanglement spreading after quantum quenches in integrable systems. In interacting models, however, it relies on the assumption that the quench creates entangled pairs of quasiparticles, which is justified only for the so-called integrable initial states. Here we go beyond this setting by studying quenches in the XXZ spin chain from the n-rainbow states, a family of macroscopically homogeneous states formed by increasingly long-range Bell pairs, which are not integrable for n>1. The local stationary state after the quench approaches the infinite-temperature state as n→infty, with corrections of order 1/n, as we show analytically. Nevertheless, in the noninteracting XX chain the quench produces entangled multiplets of 2n species of quasiparticles. Although interspecies correlations vanish as 1/n, they strongly suppress the growth of the entanglement entropy, whose rate vanishes as n→infty. We capture this behaviour within a generalized quasiparticle picture. In the interacting XXZ chain, instead, time-dependent density matrix renormalization group (tDMRG) simulations show that the entanglement entropy grows at the rate at which thermodynamic entropy is exchanged across the cut. Within the time scales accessible to tDMRG, the data show no trace of the multiplet suppression. This holds both after homogeneous quenches and after joining the n-rainbow state with an infinite-temperature state, for which we conjecture a formula for the von Neumann entropy.

full_list.title_en: Interface-Driven Remote-Surface States in Rhombohedral Graphene
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Interface-Driven Remote-Surface States in Rhombohedral Graphene
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.15192v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Rhombohedral multilayer graphene hosts low-energy states on its two outer surfaces. We identify a layer-by-layer mechanism through which a low-energy state generated at one surface acquires weight on successive layers up to the opposite surface. For an outer-layer vacancy, the wavefunction spreads over a larger area on successive layers, shifting normalized weight toward the remote surface as the system size increases. The same relation governs the extension of sublattice-polarized zero modes bound to circular voids and straight zigzag terminations. At periodic moire interfaces, it acts separately on each momentum harmonic, making the layer polarization of the low-energy bands depend on Bloch momentum and modulation period. This provides an intrinsic single-particle explanation for the remote-surface modulations observed in recent multilayer graphene experiments.

full_list.title_en: Learning Quantum Hamiltonians from the Dynamical Structure Factor
full_list.title_zh: 从动态结构因子学习量子哈密顿量
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.15859v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Identifying the microscopic interactions governing a quantum system is essential for developing predictive theories of materials and validating quantum technologies. Despite considerable progress, learning Hamiltonians from realistic experimental data remains a challenge. Motivated by neutron scattering and quantum simulations, we study the problem of learning a quantum Hamiltonian from the dynamical structure factor (DSF), which captures two-point correlation data in quantum magnets. We show that the DSF encodes sufficient information to efficiently reconstruct broad classes of quantum Hamiltonians. Our approach exploits simple relations between low-order spectral moments of the DSF and microscopic couplings, giving rise to three complementary Hamiltonian tomography protocols based on the high-temperature expansion, strong-field polarization, and the fluctuation-dissipation theorem, respectively. The framework we introduce establishes practical and robust Hamiltonian learning from common experimental data, with potentially immediate application to neutron scattering experiments.
full_list.abstract_zh: 识别控制量子系统的微观相互作用对于发展材料预测理论和验证量子技术至关重要。尽管取得了相当大的进展，但从现实的实验数据中学习哈密顿量仍然是一个挑战。受中子散射和量子模拟的推动，我们研究了从动态结构因子（DSF）学习量子哈密顿量的问题，该因子捕获量子磁体中的两点相关数据。我们证明 DSF 编码了足够的信息来有效地重建广泛的量子哈密顿量。我们的方法利用了 DSF 的低阶谱矩和微观耦合之间的简单关系，产生了分别基于高温膨胀、强场偏振和涨落耗散定理的三个互补的哈密顿断层扫描协议。

full_list.title_en: Maximally Chiral Eigenstate from Inverse Thermodynamic Bethe Ansatz
full_list.title_zh: 逆热力学的最大手性本征态 Bethe Ansatz
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.15081v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We show that an ordered quantum state can support waves with a finite speed in one direction and exponentially small energies in the other. We prescribe this spectrum for a spin-1/2 Heisenberg eigenstate and reconstruct a nonlocal Hamiltonian. The thermodynamic construction selects the ordered, current-carrying state as a ground state. Its magnetic moment remains finite while its response to a weak field has a divergent slope. The entropy per spin vanishes only inversely with a logarithm of temperature, with an exact coefficient containing the golden ratio. Our spin-response calculations reveal a bound pair whose energy can be tuned without changing its intensity. Added exchange and smoother mode selection restore quadratic excitations at the lowest energies. These results connect the design of interactions to directional dynamics and unusual thermodynamics. We propose momentum-resolved spin spectroscopy, weak-field magnetometry, and low-temperature entropy measurements to probe these counterintuitive signatures.
full_list.abstract_zh: 我们证明，有序的量子态可以支持一个方向上具有有限速度的波，而另一个方向上具有指数级小的能量的波。我们为自旋 1/2 海森堡本征态规定了这个谱，并重建了非局部哈密顿量。热力学结构选择有序的载流状态作为基态。其磁矩保持有限，而其对弱场的响应具有发散斜率。每次自旋的熵仅与温度的对数成反比消失，其中包含黄金比例的精确系数。我们的自旋响应计算揭示了一个束缚对，其能量可以在不改变其强度的情况下进行调整。增加的交换和更平滑的模式选择可恢复最低能量下的二次激励。

full_list.title_en: Termination-selective Kondo hybridization of topological surface states in CeCuAs₂
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Termination-selective Kondo hybridization of topological surface states in CeCuAs₂
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.15022v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Strongly correlated topological states in Kondo lattices represent a frontier in condensed matter physics, where the coupling between boundary electrons and localized f states can reshape the low-energy electronic structure. Here, we combine termination-resolved angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy (ARPES), Ce 4d → 4f resonant photoemission, and surface electronic structure calculations to investigate the Kondo lattice compound CeCuAs₂. Two distinct surface electronic structures are assigned to the As1 and CeAs2 terminations through their characteristic Fermi-surface geometries and termination-specific calculations. On CeAs2, a Dirac surface state associated with the calculated nontrivial bulk topology coexists with a weakly dispersive Ce 4f band near E_F. Resonant photoemission identifies the low-energy 4f character and reveals crystal-field-related fine structure in the energy range traversed by the Dirac branch. On cooling, the 4f and Dirac regions both gain spectral weight, whereas a reference conduction-band region changes much less. Together, these observations provide spectroscopic evidence for termination-selective f-Dirac hybridization and the development of 4f character in a topological surface state. Our results identify surface termination as a microscopic means of controlling the interplay between Kondo correlations and topological boundary electrons.

full_list.title_en: U(1)-Symmetric Spin SYK Models: Ordering, Chaos, and Transport
full_list.title_zh: U(1)-对称自旋 SYK 模型：有序、混沌和传输
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.15896v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The Sachdev--Ye--Kitaev (SYK) model provides an analytically controlled setting for strongly interacting quantum dynamics and holography, but its fermionic formulation leads to nonlocal encoding overheads on qubit-based quantum processors. We study a U(1)-symmetric spin analogue of the complex SYK model, constructed from random charge-conserving q-spin interactions that are native to a qubit Hilbert space. In the large-N, large-q limit, the model reproduces the leading saddle-point structure of complex fermionic SYK under the identification of chemical potential with magnetic field and charge density with magnetization. We investigate the finite-N, finite-q regime using exact diagonalization. A U(1)-invariant ordering susceptibility increases with system size for q = 2, 4 but decreases for q = 6, while bulk-spectrum level statistics are consistent with the Gaussian orthogonal ensemble at half filling and the Gaussian unitary ensemble in the adjacent magnetization sector. We further construct coupled-cluster chains and obtain domain-wall dynamics consistent with diffusive magnetization transport in a small-cluster regime accessible to matrix-product-state simulations. These results establish analytical benchmarks and finite-size signatures of ordering, quantum chaos, and magnetization transport in U(1)-symmetric spin-SYK models, and they motivate quantum simulation of the low-temperature, large-system regime, which remains difficult for classical methods.

full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构。从摘要能确认的线索包括：论文题目和摘要中可确认的方法，以及磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 声子、有限温度和输运性质对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 声子、有限温度和输运性质, 非共线磁性、DMI/Kitaev 相互作用和交替磁性在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”补充训练/验证集，再比较《U(1)-对称自旋 SYK 模型：有序、混沌和传输》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Zeroth persistent homology of ground-state correlations at clean and disordered quantum transitions
full_list.title_zh: 干净和无序量子跃迁基态相关性的零持久同源性
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.14797v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The antiferromagnetic Ising chain in transverse and longitudinal fields exhibits a continuous critical point, a mixed-order transition line and, with quenched disorder, an infinite-disorder fixed point and reentrant order. Using exact free-fermion solutions and the density-matrix renormalization group, we examine what the zeroth persistent homology of staggered ground-state correlations adds to conventional responses. Its barcode records the merge scales of the single-linkage hierarchy, and the maximum of its persistence-landscape velocity defines a threshold-free pseudocritical point. This point locates the clean critical point and the mixed-order line with an accuracy comparable to conventional responses. In the reentrant regime, the global velocity misplaces the entry, which is recovered only by restricting the filtration to the ordering scale, and none of the tested estimators locates the exit. A domain wall forced by the boundary conditions suppresses the disorder-averaged reentrant lobe. For individual disordered realizations, the labelled merge tree recovers most strong-disorder renormalization-group clusters, including noncontiguous ones missed by lattice-restricted hierarchies, with increasing agreement at stronger disorder. This information resides in the full correlation matrix, while zeroth homology provides a stable, threshold-free hierarchy.
full_list.abstract_zh: 横向和纵向场中的反铁磁伊辛链表现出连续临界点、混合序过渡线以及淬灭无序、无限无序不动点和重入序。使用精确的自由费米子解和密度矩阵重正化群，我们研究了交错基态相关性的第零个持久同源性对传统响应的影响。它的条形码记录了单链接层次结构的合并尺度，并且其持久景观速度的最大值定义了无阈值的伪临界点。该点以与传统响应相当的精度定位干净临界点和混合阶线。在重入状态下，全局速度错位了入口，只能通过将过滤限制在有序尺度来恢复，并且没有一个经过测试的估计器找到出口。

full_list.title_en: Near itinerancy and slow singlet formation in the triangular lattice NaRuO2
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Near itinerancy and slow singlet formation in the triangular lattice NaRuO2
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2607.05287v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: NaRuO₂ forms a delafossite-like structure that contains triangular sublattices of edge-sharing RuO₆ octahedra. It shows no evidence of magnetic order down to 100~mK and persistent spin fluctuations, suggestive of a quantum disordered magnetic ground state. In order to characterize the physical regime from which this disordered state arises, we use resonant inelastic X-ray scattering (RIXS) and X-ray absorption spectroscopy (XAS) at the Ru-L₂,₃-edge, along with pulsed high-field magnetization to characterize both the local electronic structure and the magnetic interactions. We infer significant spin-orbit coupling from XAS measurements. With RIXS, we observe intraorbital excitations, which are damped due to the near itinerancy of the band and suggestive of strong charge fluctuations. Corroborated by models of the high-field magnetization to a random singlet model, we propose a picture of a nearly itinerant system with strong magnetic and charge fluctuations that destabilize long-range magnetic order.

full_list.title_en: Room-Temperature Polarity Control of the Anomalous Nernst Effect in a High-Magnetic-Anisotropy Topological Nodal-Line MnAlGe
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Room-Temperature Polarity Control of the Anomalous Nernst Effect in a High-Magnetic-Anisotropy Topological Nodal-Line MnAlGe
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2608.18462v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Controlling the polarity of anomalous Nernst thermopower is a promising strategy for enhancing the performances of thermoelectric applications. However, realizing such control at room temperature (RT) in topological ferromagnets with high magnetic anisotropy (Ku) remains challenging. Here, we report RT polarity control of the anomalous Nernst effect (ANE) in quasi-two-dimensional nodal-line MnAlGe epitaxial thin films through Al/Ge compositional tuning while preserving robust high Ku. This polarity reversal originates from intrinsic Berry curvature contributions modulated by sublattice-selective carrier doping, as supported by spin-resolved electronic band structure analysis and hard X-ray photoemission spectroscopy. To demonstrate the practical feasibility, we also fabricated a meander-structured device combining MnAlGe with positive and negative polarity enhanced the thermoelectric output. Our results demonstrate that tuning the Fermi level relative to the nodal-line electronic structure while preserving high Ku enables controllable ANE polarity reversal within a single material, providing a route toward RT transverse thermoelectric devices.

full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”补充训练/验证集，再比较《Room-Temperature Polarity Control of the Anomalous Nernst Effect in a High-Magnetic-Anisotropy Topological Nodal-Line MnAlGe》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Curvature-Enhanced Polarization in Transition-Metal Dichalcogenide Janus Nanowrinkles
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Curvature-Enhanced Polarization in Transition-Metal Dichalcogenide Janus Nanowrinkles
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2609.08295v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Strain-gradient engineering via out-of-plane wrinkling offers a powerful route to tune electronic and electromechanical properties in two-dimensional (2D) materials. Here, we systematically investigate the electronic and polarization response of wrinkled Janus MoSSe/MoSeS monolayers using density functional theory (DFT) calculations coupled with continuum elastica modeling. Exploring varying wrinkle sizes and compressive strain levels (5% -- 20%), we show that the global out-of-plane polarization follows a linear behavior when parameterized by the projected aspect ratio of the nanowrinkles. On this basis, we develop a physically grounded geometric model incorporating an effective 2D electromechanical coupling coefficient, which accurately predicts DFT polarizations without requiring higher-order nonlinear parameters. Atom- and orbital-resolved charge density analyses reveal the microscopic origin of this behavior: while the central Mo 4d projected weight remains approximately constant, local curvature drives continuous, chemically asymmetric charge transfer between the S 3p and Se 4p sublayer manifolds. Our findings establish clear geometric design rules for harnessing polarization in Janus monolayers for flexible nanoelectronics and optoelectronics.

full_list.title_en: Anisotropy driven critical phenomena in a van der Waals ferromagnet
full_list.title_zh: 范德瓦尔斯铁磁体中各向异性驱动的临界现象
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.15380v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We report a detailed investigation into the field-dependent critical behavior of the van der Waals ferromagnet Fe₃GeTe₂ to elucidate how applied magnetic fields (B), strong magnetocrystalline anisotropy, and emerging other energy scales modulate its critical behavior. Utilizing the recently developed method, viz., the average of normalized slope (ANS), for analysis of critical behavior, we evaluate the critical exponents (β, γ, and δ) across distinct field windows up to rm7,T. For B applied along the crystal's easy axis (Bparallel c), the system exhibits long-range interactions dominated by competing double-exchange and itinerant Ruderman-Kittel-Kasuya-Yosida (RKKY) mechanisms, which is systematically suppressed with increasing B to converge toward the long-range 3D Ising universality class (βsim0.330, γsim1.00). Conversely, under an in-plane hard-axis configuration (Bperp c), the critical behavior study exhibits a sub-unity regime (γ<1) across the measured range of B. This behavior is attributed to the intense competitive interplay between the external Zeeman energy and strong out-of-plane magnetocrystalline anisotropy. Our findings demonstrate that critical behavior in nontrivial van der Waals magnets is fundamentally modulated by the orientation of B and the strength of magnetocrystalline anisotropy, demonstrating the necessity of B-dependent critical behavior investigation over conventional frameworks.
full_list.abstract_zh: 我们报告了对范德华铁磁体 Fe₃GeTe2 的场相关临界行为的详细研究，以阐明施加的磁场 (B)、强磁晶各向异性和新兴的其他能量尺度如何调节其临界行为。利用最近开发的方法，即归一化斜率平均值 (ANS) 来分析关键行为，我们评估了高达 rm7,T 的不同场窗口中的关键指数（β、γ 和 δ）。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 我们报告了对范德华铁磁体 Fe₃GeTe2 的场相关临界行为的详细研究，以阐明施加的磁场 (B)、强磁晶各向异性和新兴的其他能量尺度如何调节其临界行为。利用最近开发的方法，即归一化斜率平均值 (ANS) 来分析关键行为，我们评估了高达 rm7,T 的不同场窗口中的关键指数（β、γ 和 δ）。对于沿晶体易轴应用的 B（Bparallel c），系统表现出由竞争性双交换和巡回 Ruderman-Kittel-Kasuya-Yosida (RKKY) 机制主导的长程相互作用，随着 B 的增加，系统地抑制该相互作用，以向长程 3D Ising 普适性类别收敛（βsim0.330，γsim1.00）。相反，在面内硬轴配置 (Bperp c) 下，临界行为研究在 B 的测量范围内表现出亚单位状态 (γ<1)。这种行为归因于外部塞曼能量和强面外磁晶各向异性之间的激烈竞争相互作用。我们的研究结果表明，非平凡范德华磁体的关键行为从根本上是由 B 的取向和磁晶各向异性的强度调节的，这证明了在传统框架上进行依赖于 B 的关键行为研究的必要性。

full_list.title_en: Chirality-Odd Readout of Coherence-Mediated Magnon Spin Transport
full_list.title_zh: 相干介导的磁振子自旋输运的手性奇读数
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.15214v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Structural chirality is ubiquitous in magnets, yet its impact on spin transport in insulators remains largely unexplored, with only a few recent experiments offering the first glimpses. Here we predict the chiral response in the electric spin injection-detection configuration in both ferromagnetic and antiferromagnetic spirals. The screw symmetry of the spiral forbids any nonzero diagonal element of the magnon spin matrix: every eigenmode is linearly polarized and carries no spin, so spin transport is mediated entirely by superposition between distinct modes. Reversing chirality flips the magnon spin along the spiral axis and the injected quantum coherence in lockstep, leaving the associated injected spin current invariant. Spiral chirality acts instead at the detection interface, where electron--magnon scattering amplitude is reversed and causes the magnon accumulation to be read out as a voltage of opposite sign. This interfacial readout is consistent with reversed first-harmonic voltage under electric-field switching in multiferroic BiFeO₃, establishing structural chirality as an intrinsic control parameter for magnon coherence and its electrical readout.
full_list.abstract_zh: 结构手性在磁体中无处不在，但它对绝缘体自旋输运的影响在很大程度上仍未被探索，只有最近的一些实验提供了初步的了解。在这里，我们预测了铁磁和反铁磁螺旋中电自旋注入检测配置中的手性响应。螺旋的螺旋对称性禁止磁振子自旋矩阵的任何非零对角元素：每个本征模都是线性偏振的并且不携带自旋，因此自旋输运完全由不同模式之间的叠加介导。反转手性会沿着螺旋轴翻转磁振子自旋，并同步注入量子相干性，从而使相关的注入自旋电流保持不变。

full_list.title_en: Controlling the Vacuum: Tunable Magnonic Casimir Effect in Magnetic Moiré Systems
full_list.title_zh: 控制真空：磁莫尔系统中的可调谐磁波卡西米尔效应
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.14809v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We prove that the quantum fluctuations of the magnetic degrees of freedom of moiré structures can be tuned by adjusting the moiré lattice. Using the Bistritzer-MacDonald approach, we explore the consequences of this fact for the magnonic vacuum energy and the magnonic Casimir force, which become functions of the moiré pattern parameters. This allows a prototypical engine to be run with the vacuum fluctuations as a working agent and, in that way, to furnish a novel type of magneto-mechanical effect. Our calculations focus on the moiré Ladder as an example but can be generalized to any moiré structure in a straightforward fashion. We anticipate that our results belong to a generic property of moiré structures, regardless of the physical nature of the excitations at hand.
full_list.abstract_zh: 我们证明了莫尔结构磁自由度的量子涨落可以通过调整莫尔晶格来调节。使用 Bistritzer-MacDonald 方法，我们探索了这一事实对波角真空能和波角卡西米尔力的影响，它们成为莫尔图案参数的函数。这使得原型发动机能够以真空波动作为工作介质来运行，并以这种方式提供一种新型的磁机械效应。我们的计算重点以莫尔阶梯为例，但可以以简单的方式推广到任何莫尔结构。我们预计我们的结果属于莫尔结构的通用属性，无论当前激励的物理性质如何。
